# voipms_caller_id_filter (Data Source)

Reads a caller-ID filter by id (`getCallerIDFiltering`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_caller_id_filter" "blocked_prefix" {
  id = "4001"
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Filter id.

### Read-Only

- `callerid` (String) Caller ID pattern.
- `did` (String) DID this rule applies to, or `all`.
- `failover_busy` (String) Busy failover route.
- `failover_noanswer` (String) No-answer failover route.
- `failover_unreachable` (String) Unreachable failover route.
- `note` (String) Note.
- `routing` (String) Route for matched calls.
